notes: Source read in full (RH reported text, 275 lines / ~12.7K chars). referencedSources empty; criticisms[] and featured_quotes[] are Congressional Record quotes with no CR source file provided, so they were out of audit scope (bill-text-only). No material fidelity errors: every figure (180 days, 60 days, 120 days, 2 years, seven committees, Sections 107(a)/(d), 103, 104(b)(4)), direction (limit/bar/transfer/strike/add), and named entity resolves to the bill source. Minor items: dropped 'to the extent practicable' hedge in one main line; add-vs-modify nuance on the 104(b)(4) requirement; three likelihoodReason framing lines (231 cosponsors is structural metadata, causal/predictive claims). Three minor omissions (building criteria, effective date, fourth approver). Stage/vote consistent: stage 'dead'/'Failed in House' matches votes[] On Passage Failed 204-216.
